text:
anya (PM): Quick sync — need alignment on resourcing & sequencing for the tiered-SLA roadmap. Customer requirement: predictable p99 ~200ms for core flows, fallback to hosted variants. Decision window: EOD Thu.
kevin (runtime): summary of runtime work: KV cache TTL tuning, continuous batching tweaks, and an endpoint for quantized variants. Need a microbenchmark pass. ~2 dev-weeks.
matt (eng-infra): infra asks: reserved capacity (monthly commit) + autoscale policy changes, network egress tests for 2 regions. Estimate 2 infra engineers 6w if we include multi-AZ. If we cut multi-AZ to single region can save ~3w.
sarah (infra): also need storage sizing for prefix cache (~1TB initially), cross-region replication plan if we do multi-region. We should lock the target RPS to size pools.
lina (security): KMS/HSM integration + audit log retention + pre-launch threat model. Not a hard blocker but needs kickoff now — ~3w for dev + 1w for review. Need to know whether customer data will be in KV cache (PII?)
jordan (release): proposed launch criteria (draft): p99 <250ms for 75% traffic on canary, error rate <0.5%, rollout must have automated rollback. Canary: 5% for 48h, then 25% for 72h. Need signoff on metrics and runbook.
anya (PM): thanks. Two tradeoff questions: 1) postpone multi-region to post-launch? 2) reduce initial traffic target to 50% to compress infra work? Thoughts?
kevin (runtime): postponing multi-region is fine. We can get p99 to target with tuning + 8-bit quantized model for golden path. That reduces runtime risk.
matt (eng-infra): lowering traffic to 50% cuts infra scope by ~30% — fewer reserved GPUs upfront. That means lower cost and faster delivery. We'll still need a burst plan.
sarah (infra): agree to 50% initial, but we need clear SLOs for fallback to hosted for overflow. Also need to run chaos tests on autoscaler.
lina (security): 50% rollout doesn't change KMS requirement; we can do a phased KMS enablement per environment. 
anya (PM): ok — new proposal: scope-minimize for launch: single region, 50% traffic, KMS in canary only, rollout phases below. Need every team owner to accept timelines.
```
Rollout phases (proposal):
Phase 0: Canary 5% (48h) — metrics: p99, error rate, fallback success
Phase 1: Ramp to 25% (72h) — enable KMS in canary env, run perf tests
Phase 2: Ramp to 50% (72h) — autoscale enabled, prefix cache active
Phase 3: Post-launch: multi-region + 100% ramp
```
kevin (runtime): fine with phases. I request a short profiling sprint (3 days) before Phase 0 to validate batch sizes.
matt (eng-infra): I'll scope reserved capacity and a burst pool. Need decision on commit level by Monday.
sarah (infra): I'll schedule chaos + perf tests. Need test harness from runtime by Friday.
lina (security): I'll start KMS ticket and threat model. ETA for initial KMS hook: 3w.
jordan (release): I'll draft runbook and rollback playbook. Can we agree on the guardrails for automatic rollback? Suggest: if p99 increases >20% or error rate >1% for 10m -> rollback.
anya (PM): agreed on rollback thresholds. Action items:
- kevin: profiling sprint + perf harness (due Fri)
- matt: reserve capacity proposal + commit options (due Mon)
- sarah: chaos test plan + infra scripts (due Mon)
- lina: KMS ticket + threat model kickoff (due Mon)
- jordan: runbook + rollback playbook draft (due Tue)
deploy-bot: scheduled: rollout-checklist created for thread 1745001234.
anya (PM): thanks everyone — will collate into a one-pager and circulate. :thumbsup:
